title: Fast Log-Domain Sinkhorn Optimal Transport with Warp-Level GPU Reductions
tldr_zh: 原生 CUDA log-domain Sinkhorn，warp shuffle 归约，n=8192 比 POT 快 12×，ε 低至 1e-4 稳定
